content: Keriso Jesu Ana Bowayan Gewasin
Baise natu, Keriso Jesu ana manaw ana kabeber wanawananamaim inafair.
Bai’obaiyen sifrubonayah maumurih nahimaim abinan inonowar inab, naatu sabuw iyab kubitutumih, iti tur inaya’abun hinab, saise i auman sabuw afa hini’obaiyih.
Aki biyai ebababanabe obo auman aunowa biya nababan Keriso Jesu ana baiyowayan gewasin na’atube.
Orot yait sorodiy ana bowabowamaim ema’am i boro turobe nabow ana orot ukwarin niyasisir, men natit ufun bar merar ana bowabow auman nagamuw nabowamih.
Orot nunuw isan ebowabow gaigiwas boro men asir nanunuw turahinah ni’iyonsairih siwar nabaimih, baise nunuw ana bai’obaiyen hibi’obaiy ni’ufunun boro nanunuw turahinah ni’iyonsairih.
Orot yait masaw bow raro’on ebababan hinafafour ana veya, nati orot i boro wan hinakusib aunowan hinitin.
Abisa ao i nuhimaim nama inanot, naatu Regah boro nibaisi nuhi nakusisib sawar etei ao inaso’ob.
Jesu Keriso, David uwan, morobone God iyawas maiye mimisir, i ayu au Tur Gewasin ukwarin nati i abibinan.
Anayabin ayu Tur Gewasin abibinan isan biyababan abaib, ana itinin i bainowan orot na’atube hifatumu ama’am. Baise God ana tur i men hifatum.

Isan imih God ana sabuw rurubinih wabihimaim ayu biyababan fokarih etei wanawanah arun ewawainabu, saise i auman Keriso Jesu’une yawas enan hinab naatu yawas ma’ama wanatowan ana bonamanamarin wanawanan hinarun.
Iti tur i turobe,

content.text: anayabin i men karam boro taiyuwin nifuwifuw.”

content: God Orot Ana Bowabow Isan Ebibasit

A sabuw hai tur ina’owen nuhih inakusib iti sawar isah, God nanamaim tur fokarin ina’uwih inimatnuwih; sawar hai yabih en, isah men turamaim hinagam. Nati boro men ana gewasin ta hinab, baise sabuw iyab tur tenonowar i tigugurusih.
Baise inabow sunusunub, God na’iti o i turobe kubowabow, naatu God ana tur yabin inaso’ob gewas sabuw ini’obaiyih, saise kubowabow isan God nabibatiy boro men biya na’ohow.
Sabuw iyab God men tekakakafiy naatu koko’awabe teo’okwanekwan kwanahaiwih, anayabin sabuw boro hinanawiyih God biyanamaim hinatit hai ef nawarorom.
Hai bai’obaiyen i roufair orot biyan ean gegedar enan na’atube. Wanawanahimaim i orot rou’ab, Haimeneus naatu Philetus hairi iti bai’obaiyen tibi’obaiyi i kwana’itin gewas.

Iti orot rou’ab bai’obaiyen anababatun hikwahir hitit, naatu hai binanumaim hio morobone misir maiye i mataraka, boro men namatar maiye’emih, iti na’atube hio baitumatumayah afa hai baitumatum tigugurus.

Baise God ana taf badowanin rarouw i boro men yait ta niyuyuw. Iti taf afe’enamaim tur iti hikirum, “Regah so’ob iyab i nowan.” naatu “Iyab teo ayu i Regah nowan gewasin kakafihine dogor baikitabir hinab.”
Bar gagamin wanawanan ror kafet, hai yumat i ta ta, afa i silver, naatu afa i gold, afa i tew, afa i naukwat, naatu iti sawar afa i bowabow gagamih isah, afa i bowabow gidigidih isah.
Orot yait kakafihine nahaiw taiyuwin nakukusouw na’at, karam boro hinab sawar gagamih isan nabow, anayabin i taiyuwin ya’asair ana orot ukwarin isan bowamih yabuna.

Monok ana yawas kwanahaiw, yawas yamutufurin, baitumatum, yabow, tufuw, isah a not imaim kwanayai kwananuwih kwanab, Kirisiyan afa dogoroh rousouwin bairi kwanita’imon Regah ana baibais isan kwanifefeyan.
Baise sabuw hai not en koko’aw sabuw na’atube kwanahaiwih; kwanaso’ob nati sabuw i gamin baibuya’ayah.
Regah ana akirwairafin i men nagam kwanekwan, baise sabuw etei isah nigewasin, yaten nanub ni’obaiyih.
Tur hamehamenamaim sabuw iyab i tirurukoukuw nayamutufurih, God boro hai ef niwa’an naham dogor baikitabir hinab naatu hinan turobe hinaso’ob.
Naatu hai not namatabir maiye nan natitit ana veya’amaim, demon buwih fatumih hima fanan hibai ana kok hisisinaf boro hinahaiw hinatit.
